test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

A __health person may__ carry germs of typhoid, cholera, dysentery, etc. in his body.
solution:
The correct answer is "**healthy person may**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the use of the word "health" is incorrect.
 
• The use of noun "health" is incorrect.
 
• The sentence requires an adjective for the noun "person."
 
• **The correct word to use is "healthy" which means someone showing good health**.
 
 
• Example: A healthy individual, a healthy baby.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct sentence will be:
 
 
• A healthy person may carry germs of typhoid, cholera, dysentery, etc. in his body.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.
